remarks: Step into effortless elegance with this beautifully appointed one-bedroom unit in the highly sought-after Regency Towers. Nestled in a prime central location, this doorman building offers the perfect blend of convenience and luxury. Inside, an open-concept living and dining area creates a seamless flow, ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The updated kitchen boasts gleaming granite countertops, rich wooden cabinetry, and ample storage-perfect for any home chef. The generously sized bedroom is a serene retreat, complete with abundant closet space to keep everything neatly organized. A stylish full bath adds to the home's charm. Parquet floors throughout (except for tile in the kitchen and bathroom) and high ceilings enhance the sense of space and light. Natural sunlight pours into the home, while the large screened-in balcony provides a peaceful oasis to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening. Don't miss the chance to experience easy, elegant living in Regency Towers!
